hook_text: More than two million stone blocks, and no cranes. How did they do it?
clip_script: Pietermaritzburg. A sugar-cube pyramid, a clay Sphinx, a cardboard temple. The real Great Pyramid, built for Khufu about four and a half thousand years ago, was a tomb for the afterlife. Workers cut stone with copper chisels, floated it on the Nile, dragged it on sledges over wet sand, and raised it on ramps. They were paid workers, not slaves. The Sphinx: carved from rock. The temples: houses of the gods.
visual_style: Whiteboard sugar cubes stacking into a pyramid, a sledge sliding over wet sand, the Sphinx emerging from rock, then a temple gateway.
mood: Amazed and adventurous, like uncovering a great mystery.
pacing: Builds up block by block, then reveals the Sphinx and temple.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build your own pyramid from sugar cubes or blocks.
